summary: Wrote a 3-phase, 3-hour conclusion plan for the report-only transfer-ledger task. Phase 1 discharges the dispatch's VERIFICATION clause by re-running every command the report records and pinning the tree state; Phase 2 renders the report's six recommendations as a backlog-reconciled proposal packet (proposals.json + audit NDJSON + a Component 7 confirmation table) without filing anything; Phase 3 bridges the findings into issues.jsonl with suggested_channel follow_up_task so the conclusion stage can see them, and runs the full gate. No phase touches FormalSystem/, allocates a task number, or writes specs/state.json.
